title: Um conserto que não resolveu
scene: At a quiet neighbourhood bicycle repair counter. Sparky is a customer; Pinky is the mechanic. They resolve a recurring brake problem before a work commute.
context: Natural clear conversation at 135 to 150 words per minute. Brief thoughtful pauses between turns; no music, sound effects or overlapping speech. Sparky is concerned but polite; Pinky is practical and reassuring. Read only the dialogue, never the directions or speaker labels.

turns.speaker: sparky
turns.text: Hi, I brought my bike in on Monday because the front brake kept sticking. It seemed fine when I collected it, but the same thing happened on my way to work this morning. Could we take another look?
turns.translation: Oi, trouxe minha bicicleta na segunda porque o freio dianteiro ficava travando. Parecia tudo certo quando a busquei, mas aconteceu de novo no caminho para o trabalho hoje. Podemos verificar outra vez?

turns.speaker: pinky
turns.text: Of course. I'm sorry it hasn't held up. Do you have the repair receipt? I need to check whether we replaced the cable or just adjusted it. That makes a difference to what we should try next.
turns.translation: Claro. Desculpe que o conserto não tenha durado. Você tem o recibo? Preciso conferir se trocamos o cabo ou apenas o ajustamos. Isso muda o próximo procedimento.

turns.speaker: sparky
turns.text: Here it is. I don't mind waiting a little, but I need a reliable way to get to work tomorrow. I'd rather have the actual problem fixed than keep coming back for a quick adjustment.
turns.translation: Aqui está. Não me importo de esperar um pouco, mas preciso de um meio confiável de ir trabalhar amanhã. Prefiro resolver o problema de fato a voltar sempre para um ajuste rápido.

turns.speaker: pinky
turns.text: That's reasonable. We adjusted the old cable, so I'll inspect the housing as well this time. I can finish the check by four, although I can't promise the repair until I know whether a part is needed.
turns.translation: Faz sentido. Ajustamos o cabo antigo, então desta vez também vou examinar a capa. Consigo terminar a inspeção até as quatro, mas só poderei prometer o conserto quando souber se é necessária uma peça.

turns.speaker: sparky
turns.text: Thanks for being clear. Please call before doing any extra work. If it needs to stay overnight, is there a bike I could borrow?
turns.translation: Obrigado pela clareza. Por favor, ligue antes de fazer qualquer serviço adicional. Se ela precisar ficar à noite, há uma bicicleta emprestada?

turns.speaker: pinky
turns.text: Yes, we have a loan bike. I'll reserve it now and call by four with the findings and any cost. You can then decide how to proceed.
turns.translation: Sim, temos uma bicicleta para empréstimo. Vou reservá-la e ligar até as quatro com o diagnóstico e qualquer custo. Você poderá decidir como seguir.

gist.question: What outcome does Sparky mainly want?
choices: A reliable repair with a clear plan
A refund for a completely new bike
gist.explanation: Sparky contrasts fixing the actual problem with repeatedly returning for quick adjustments. He accepts a short wait and asks for a plan.

detail.question: What does Pinky promise by four?
choices: The inspection findings and a call
A completed repair regardless of parts
detail.explanation: The deadline covers the check and the call. Pinky explicitly avoids promising completion before knowing whether a part is needed.

inference.question: What does Sparky's request to call before extra work suggest?
choices: He wants to approve the next steps and costs
He has decided to reject every repair
He doubts that the shop owns a telephone
inference.explanation: He continues cooperating and asks for prior contact. The reasonable inference is control over further work, not total refusal.

mediation: Um colega precisa buscar a bicicleta por você e só lê português. Escreva uma mensagem de 60–90 palavras que distinga o que foi prometido do que ainda depende da inspeção. Inclua o empréstimo e a autorização de custos; não invente que o conserto já terminou.
